params.prompt: Seamless tileable surface texture of warm kraft cardboard fibers. Subtle fine paper grain, no writing, no symbols, no tape, no seams or panel divisions, no corrugation ridges. The postal facility uses muted sage enamel, charcoal rubber and warm aged timber; workers and parcels use ochre canvas and cream cardboard, while lime green and dusty coral identify unusual interactions. Soft warm practical lighting meets cool skylight, creating a slightly absurd working depot rather than a fantasy ruin. Readable silhouettes and material separation suit a free third-person camera; concept objects use a three-quarter isometric view. Perfectly seamless edges, flat even lighting, no perspective, no objects, photographed-flat appearance.
